subject: maths
question: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of 1,60,000 is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
solution:
**Given:**

Current Population = 1,60,000

Growth Rate = 25% per year

Time 3 years ago and 2 years ago

**Formula used:**

Population after t years = Current Population × (1 + r/100)⁻t

Where, r = growth rate

**Calculations:**

Population 3 years ago = 1,60,000 × (1 + 25/100)⁻³

Population 2 years ago = 1,60,000 × (1 + 25/100)-2

Difference = 1,60,000 × (1 + 25/100)-3 - 1,60,000 × (1 + 25/100)-2

Difference = 1,60,000 × (1 + 25/100)⁻²[1 - 1.25⁻¹]

Difference = 1,60,000 × (5/4)-2[1 - (5/4)-1]

Difference = 1,60,000 × (4/5)2[1 - (4/5)]

Difference = 1,60,000 × (4/5)2[1/5]

Difference = 1,60,000 × (4/5) × (4/5) × (1/5)

⇒ Difference = 20,480

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
